limits: No model/tracker/encoder/resolver inference is rerun by this audit.
Actual CUDA kernels and feature hashes/norms are retained evidence; embeddings/cost matrix vectors are not retained for independent vector recomputation.
Parent-formula equality is a source-bound runtime observer assertion whose shapes/counters/flags are independently reconciled, not an independent numerical cost-vector replay.
Machine accepted candidate subtotals are scoped to five declared windows, not full-video traffic volume.
Cross-variant physical passage identity, split leakage, false merges/duplicates and enhancement benefit require separate pixel/temporal review.
Software artifact correctness is not accuracy/precision/recall/F1/MAPE or physical-identity ground truth.
